notes.title: Aluna: Sentinel of the Shards Patch 1.09
notes.content: Thank you all for choosing our game.  We just released patch 1.09 bug fixes and performance improvements.  We appreciate you all !!! We have some exciting news coming soon !

notes.title: Aluna: Sentinel of the Shards Joins the Steam Summer Sale
notes.content: Aluna: Sentinel of the Shards is now officially part of the Steam Summer Sale. This exciting new twist on action-RPG storytelling continues from the comic book series (The World of Aluna), written by the award winning writers of Assassins Creed and Batman: Arkham Origins.
